$comment: Text pool for the God's Will prayer category.
requests: Wisdom for a job offer that came out of nowhere.

We have been offered a position in Colorado that would mean leaving our family and church here in Mesa. It is a great opportunity, but we do not want to move ahead of God. Praying for clear direction.
My husband and I are seriously considering becoming foster parents. We have done the classes and the home study is next. Asking God to show us if this is the right season for our family.
I feel a pull toward full-time ministry but I have a stable career and two kids in school. I do not want to ignore a calling, and I do not want to chase a feeling either. Praying for discernment.
Our daughter is choosing between two colleges, one close to home and one out of state. She wants to make the choice God has for her. Please pray for peace about the decision.
Should we sell our house and downsize? We keep going back and forth on it. Asking the Lord for a clear yes or no.
I was offered a promotion that comes with a lot more travel. The money would help, but I worry about time away from my family. Praying I choose wisely and not out of fear.

My wife and I have talked about adoption for years. We already have two kids and a pretty full life, but neither of us can shake the feeling that God has more children for our family. We are meeting with an agency next month. We would be grateful for prayer that God would close the door if it is not His plan, and open it wide if it is.
Trying to decide whether to move my mom in with us or help her find assisted living near our home in Gilbert. Both options have hard parts. Pray for wisdom and for her to feel loved either way.
Considering going back to school at 45 to become a nurse. It feels crazy and exciting at the same time. Asking God to confirm this if it is from Him.
We are choosing a school for our son with special needs and the options feel overwhelming. Pray we find the place where he will be seen and helped.
Direction for my next step after graduation.
Our family is praying about whether to join the team that is starting a new campus on the west side. It would mean changing churches for our kids too. Seeking God's will together.
I was laid off and now I have two very different offers on the table. One is safe and one is a risk I am excited about. I want to follow God and not just my own plans.

For a decision my husband and I need to make about retirement. We could stay in Arizona near the grandkids or move back to Ohio where we both grew up and where his brother needs help. There is no wrong answer, but we want to be where God wants us for this last chapter. Praying that we both feel the same peace about it and that it would not cause any strain between us.
details: We have made lists, talked to people we trust, and prayed a lot, but we still do not have a clear answer.
I keep reminding myself that God is not hiding His will from me. He will make the path clear.
The deadline is coming up soon, so prayer for clarity in the next few weeks would mean a lot.
I do not want to make this choice out of fear or out of pride. I just want to be obedient.
If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally (James 1:5, WEB). So I am asking.
Pray for peace in our home while we wait, and for unity among everyone this decision affects.
answers: God answered! The door opened in a way we could not have planned. Thank you for praying with us.
We made the decision and have real peace about it. Thank you all for your prayers.
Still waiting on a clear answer, but I am not anxious about it anymore. God has given me patience.
One door closed, which was hard, but it brought clarity. We are trusting Him with the next step.
Thank you for praying. We have a direction now, even if not every detail is figured out.
Nothing decided yet. Grateful for your prayers as we keep listening.
